content.text:
I built the vote-by-mail flyer in scene sed29071b6b and rendered all three sizes: portrait 1080×1350, wide 1200×1000 and sky 300×600. The layout checker found no defects in any of them.

- **Resizing:** The headline, photo band and red "VOTE BY MAIL" bar stay full width at every size. The photo crops to fit instead of stretching, and the three candidate columns stay evenly spaced.
- **Sky text sizes:** At sky's 0.28 scale the smallest text would have been about 6px, so I set larger font sizes for that size only. Its smallest text is now the footer at about 10px, and the headline wraps to three lines at 27px.
- **Wide layout:** The three steps stay left-aligned rather than centred, so there's empty space on the right.

The renders are PNGs named portrait-v5, wide-v5 and sky-v5 in `/var/folders/hf/35wnqrnj2bbb1_llbg87zlt40000gn/T/scene-mcp-e2e-llm-90885/renders/sed29071b6b/`.
